meaning.en: A sudden, undeserved disaster that strikes out of nowhere.
meaning.zh: 意外飞来的灾祸。

examples.zh: 他好好走在人行道上，却遭遇了一场飞来横祸。
examples.en: He was simply walking along the pavement when disaster struck out of nowhere.

examples.zh: 一场车祸，对这个家庭来说是飞来横祸。
examples.en: The car crash was a sudden, undeserved calamity for the family.

usage.en: Object or subject; often 遭遇/遭此飞来横祸.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“遭遇飞来横祸”。

meaning.en: To keep coming up with new forms or tricks (sometimes disapproving).
meaning.zh: 花色式样不断更新，也比喻变换新的手法。

examples.zh: 商家的促销手段花样翻新，让人眼花缭乱。
examples.en: Shops keep inventing new promotional gimmicks, it's dizzying.

examples.zh: 她做的早餐天天花样翻新。
examples.en: She makes something different for breakfast every day.

examples.zh: 诈骗手法不断花样翻新，大家要提高警惕。
examples.en: Scammers keep coming up with new tricks, so stay alert.

usage.en: Predicate; neutral or slightly disapproving (of tricks).
usage.zh: 多作谓语；指手段时含贬义。

meaning.en: Set against hills and beside water; describing a beautiful location.
meaning.zh: 靠着山，临着水，形容地理位置优美。

equivalents: with mountains behind and a river in front

examples.zh: 这个小村庄依山傍水，风景如画。
examples.en: The village nestles between the hills and the river, pretty as a picture.

examples.zh: 学校依山傍水，环境十分幽静。
examples.en: The school sits by hills and water in very peaceful surroundings.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for places.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，形容地方。

meaning.en: Everything is fine; often used ironically for thinking a problem is solved.
meaning.zh: 一切事情都很圆满顺利；常用于反问或否定，指以为事情就此解决。

examples.zh: 别以为考上大学就万事大吉了。
examples.en: Don't think getting into university means you've got it made.

examples.zh: 合同一签，就万事大吉了。
examples.en: Once the contract is signed, we're home and dry.

examples.zh: 装了杀毒软件不等于万事大吉。
examples.en: Installing antivirus software doesn't mean everything's fine.

usage.en: Predicate; often in 以为……就万事大吉了 (warning against complacency).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“别以为……就万事大吉了”。

natural: risk one's life to save others

meaning.en: To sacrifice oneself to save others.
meaning.zh: 不惜牺牲自己去救别人。

equivalents: lay down one's life for others

examples.zh: 他舍己救人的事迹感动了全国。
examples.en: His self-sacrifice to save others moved the whole nation.

examples.zh: 那位司机舍己救人，被授予见义勇为奖。
examples.en: The driver risked his life to save others and received a bravery award.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; common in news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常见于新闻报道。

meaning.en: To want to stop but be unable to; hooked.
meaning.zh: 想停止却停不下来。

examples.zh: 这部小说太好看了，让人欲罢不能。
examples.en: This novel is so good you can't put it down.

examples.zh: 刷短视频容易让人欲罢不能。
examples.en: Scrolling short videos can get you hooked.

examples.zh: 比赛打到加时，球迷们看得欲罢不能。
examples.en: The match went to extra time and the fans couldn't tear themselves away.

story.en: Yan Hui on studying with Confucius: 'I want to stop but cannot, though I have exhausted my abilities' (欲罢不能，既竭吾才).
story.zh: 《论语》：颜渊喟然叹曰：“……欲罢不能，既竭吾才。”

usage.en: Predicate; often 让人欲罢不能.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“让人欲罢不能”。

meaning.en: Beating gongs and drums in celebration; also, making a big fuss in public.
meaning.zh: 敲着锣，打着鼓，形容欢庆热闹；也比喻大张旗鼓。

examples.zh: 村民们敲锣打鼓，欢迎考上大学的孩子。
examples.en: The villagers beat gongs and drums to welcome the child who had got into university.

examples.zh: 春节庙会上，人们敲锣打鼓，十分热闹。
examples.en: At the Spring Festival fair, people beat gongs and drums; it was very lively.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.

meaning.en: Extremely cruel and vicious.
meaning.zh: 形容极端残暴凶恶。

examples.zh: 警方终于抓获了这伙穷凶极恶的歹徒。
examples.en: The police finally caught the vicious gang.

examples.zh: 那个穷凶极恶的罪犯被判了死刑。
examples.en: The utterly ruthless criminal was sentenced to death.

story.en: Used of the usurper Wang Mang: 'utterly vicious, his poison spread through the land' (穷凶极恶，毒流诸夏).
story.zh: 《汉书·王莽传》：“穷凶极恶，毒流诸夏。”

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; for criminals, enemies.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，形容罪犯、敌人。

meaning.en: To share both good times and bad; closely bound together.
meaning.zh: 同欢乐，共忧患，形容关系密切，利害一致。

equivalents: stand together through thick and thin

examples.zh: 两国人民休戚与共，命运相连。
examples.en: The two peoples share each other's joys and sorrows; their fates are linked.

examples.zh: 团队成员休戚与共，才能渡过难关。
examples.en: Only if the team stick together through thick and thin can they get through this.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; formal, common in diplomatic language.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；常用于外交辞令。

meaning.en: To set each other off and create a pleasing effect.
meaning.zh: 互相衬托，显得很有趣味。

examples.zh: 古老的寺庙和现代高楼相映成趣。
examples.en: The ancient temple and the modern towers make a charming contrast.

examples.zh: 红花绿叶，相映成趣。
examples.en: Red flowers and green leaves set each other off beautifully.

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: Impartial, favouring neither side; also, exactly on target.
meaning.zh: 不偏向任何一方，公正；也指正中目标。

examples.zh: 裁判必须不偏不倚。
examples.en: A referee must be impartial.

examples.zh: 这篇报道不偏不倚地呈现了双方观点。
examples.en: The report presents both sides even-handedly.

examples.zh: 飞镖不偏不倚，正中靶心。
examples.en: The dart hit the bull's-eye dead centre.

story.en: Zhu Xi glossed the Confucian 'mean' (中) as 'neither leaning nor tilting, neither excess nor deficiency' (不偏不倚，无过不及).
story.zh: 朱熹《中庸章句》：“中者，不偏不倚、无过不及之名。”

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.

meaning.en: To act as a go-between and bring parties together.
meaning.zh: 比喻从中联系、撮合。

examples.zh: 在他的穿针引线下，两家公司达成了合作。
examples.en: Thanks to his brokering, the two companies agreed to work together.

examples.zh: 是王阿姨穿针引线，他们俩才认识的。
examples.en: It was Auntie Wang who played matchmaker and introduced them.

usage.en: Predicate; also 在某人的穿针引线下.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也说“在……的穿针引线下”。

meaning.en: To strive hard to catch up with those ahead.
meaning.zh: 加紧追上最前面的。

examples.zh: 我们的技术还落后，必须迎头赶上。
examples.en: Our technology still lags behind; we must catch up.

examples.zh: 他落后了一圈，但很快迎头赶上。
examples.en: He was a lap behind but soon closed the gap.

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: when in Rome, do as the Romans do

meaning.en: To follow local customs wherever you go.
meaning.zh: 到一个地方就顺从当地的风俗习惯。

equivalents: when in Rome, do as the Romans do

examples.zh: 到了国外要入乡随俗，尊重当地文化。
examples.en: Abroad you should do as the locals do and respect their culture.

examples.zh: 他入乡随俗，也学会了用筷子。
examples.en: When in Rome — he learnt to use chopsticks too.

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: Too weak to withstand a single blow.
meaning.zh: 经不起一打，形容力量薄弱。

examples.zh: 对方的防线不堪一击。
examples.en: The opposing defence crumbled at the first attack.

examples.zh: 他的论点不堪一击。
examples.en: His argument falls apart under the slightest scrutiny.

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: Knowledgeable, far-sighted people.
meaning.zh: 有见识的人。

examples.zh: 越来越多的有识之士关注环境问题。
examples.en: More and more far-sighted people are paying attention to the environment.

examples.zh: 这一问题引起了社会各界有识之士的担忧。
examples.en: The issue has worried informed observers across society.

usage.en: Subject or object; formal, common in news.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语；书面语，常见于新闻。

meaning.en: Utterly enthralled, as if entranced or drunk.
meaning.zh: 形容神态失常、不能自制，多指极度陶醉。

examples.zh: 观众被她的歌声迷得如痴如醉。
examples.en: The audience were spellbound by her singing.

examples.zh: 他读武侠小说读得如痴如醉。
examples.en: He was utterly absorbed in martial-arts novels.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; often ……得如痴如醉.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，常说“……得如痴如醉”。

meaning.en: Earth-shattering change; also, utter turmoil.
meaning.zh: 形容变化巨大；也形容闹得很凶。

examples.zh: 几十年来，家乡发生了天翻地覆的变化。
examples.en: Over the decades my hometown has changed beyond recognition.

examples.zh: 两个孩子把家里闹得天翻地覆。
examples.en: The two kids turned the house upside down.

usage.en: Attributive (……的变化) or complement (闹得天翻地覆).

meaning.en: To be destroyed in an instant (usually something built over a long time).
meaning.zh: 在一天之内被毁掉，指长期的成果顷刻毁灭。

examples.zh: 一场大火，让百年老店毁于一旦。
examples.en: A single fire destroyed the century-old shop overnight.

examples.zh: 多年积累的信誉，可能因一次失误毁于一旦。
examples.en: A reputation built over years can be wiped out by one mistake.

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: Just a few words; fragmentary remarks.
meaning.zh: 个别的词句；片段的话。

examples.zh: 他走时只留下只言片语。
examples.en: He left with only a few words.

examples.zh: 不能根据只言片语就下结论。
examples.en: You can't jump to conclusions from a few snippets.

usage.en: Object; often 只言片语也没有.

meaning.en: Men of virtue and high ideals (often patriots who sacrificed for a cause).
meaning.zh: 有仁德、有志向的人。

examples.zh: 无数仁人志士为民族独立献出了生命。
examples.en: Countless patriots gave their lives for national independence.

examples.zh: 近代的仁人志士探索救国之路。
examples.en: Modern idealists searched for ways to save the country.

usage.en: Subject or object; formal, historical writing.

meaning.en: To meet by chance without arranging it.
meaning.zh: 没有约定而意外地相遇。

examples.zh: 我在机场和老同学不期而遇。
examples.en: I bumped into an old classmate at the airport.

examples.zh: 两人在书店不期而遇，聊了一下午。
examples.en: They ran into each other at the bookshop and chatted all afternoon.

story.en: The Guliang commentary defines 遇 as 'meeting without prior arrangement' (不期而会曰遇).

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: To take a global view; to look beyond one's own surroundings.
meaning.zh: 把眼光放到全世界。

examples.zh: 年轻人要放眼世界，开阔视野。
examples.en: Young people should look to the wider world and broaden their horizons.

examples.zh: 放眼世界，很少有国家能做到这一点。
examples.en: Look around the world: few countries have managed this.

usage.en: Predicate; also sentence-initial (放眼世界，……).

meaning.en: Brimming with wit and charm (speech, writing, art).
meaning.zh: 洋溢着美妙的意趣，多指语言、文章或美术品。

examples.zh: 他的演讲妙趣横生，笑声不断。
examples.en: His talk was full of wit and the laughter never stopped.

examples.zh: 这本科普书写得妙趣横生。
examples.en: This popular-science book is delightfully written.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

meaning.en: Like looking for a needle in the sea; almost impossible to find.
meaning.zh: 在大海里捞一根针，比喻极难找到。

examples.zh: 在这么大的城市找一个人，简直是大海捞针。
examples.en: Finding one person in a city this big is like looking for a needle in a haystack.

examples.zh: 没有线索，查起来如同大海捞针。
examples.en: Without leads, the investigation is a hopeless search.

usage.en: Predicate or object; often 如同/简直是大海捞针.
